summary: Iteration 14 (FishyLand rename round). Tested: new homepage (desktop 1920 + mobile 390), login modal, signup, the Inventory label, tapping another angler to open their profile, and the full 3-minute live duel result flow in the UI and the API. Everything requested passes. One environment issue: the dev server was serving a stale index.html with the title 'Fishing Realms'. A frontend restart fixed it, and the title now reads 'FishyLand · Fantasy Fishing MMO'.

minor.issue: _active() only matches duels whose end is later than now-300s. About 5 minutes after the duel ends, state goes back to 'idle' and DuelHud sends the player to the harbour without a click. That is fine for normal use, but the result does not stay 'until Back is pressed' forever.

ui_bugs.component: Profile modal opened by tapping another angler
ui_bugs.issue: The header says 'MY ANGLER' while showing TestAngler2's profile. The subtitle says 'Fishing at Millbrook Pond' while that player is in the harbour.

issues: Another angler standing on the spawn point overlaps your own character, and their hitArea catches the tap. Tapping your own spot opens their profile instead of walking.

action_items: Optional: change the profile modal title to the angler's name or 'Angler' when it is not your own profile
Optional: remove the dead code in Landing.js (SHOTS, ABOUT, GUIDES, icon, Motes, the Users import are unused)
Optional: 'Fishing Realms' remains in a comment in src/tfl/tfl.css (not visible to users)
critical_code_review_comments: Landing.js: the SHOTS, ABOUT, GUIDES, icon and Motes constants and the Users icon import are unused after the redesign
duel_live._active uses a 300s grace window. Document it, or show a 'result expired' notice before the auto-redirect
public/index.html title changes need a frontend restart in dev (CRA does not hot reload it). Restarted during the test

success_rate.backend: 100% (1/1 long e2e test with 9 assertions, plus manual checks)

verified: Homepage loads lp-mascot, speech bubble, lp-logo, lp-board (teak panel.webp border-image) with the signup form, and 4 screenshots (harbour/river/map/shop), all with naturalWidth 960
No 'Fishing Realms' in visible text. Title is 'FishyLand · Fantasy Fishing MMO' after the restart
lp-login-toggle opens lp-login-modal. A click outside closes it. A wrong password shows 'Wrong name, email or password'. TestAngler login goes to /game in harbour mode
Mobile 390: scrollWidth is 390, no overflowing elements. A new account (TEST_fl6520) signed up and landed in /game with a welcome toast
Tapping TestAngler2's character on the canvas navigated to /game/profile/TestAngler2

UI duel: both players queued and matched, the scoreboard counted down, both saw 'Draw' and the result stayed for 15s+. A clicked Back and went to harbour mode while B still saw the result. B clicked Back and went to the harbour
API: after the end, both players get phase 'done' and result 'draw' for 20s of polling. After A leaves, A is idle and B is still 'done'. A can queue again fresh. After B leaves, B is idle
seed_data_creation: Created account TEST_fl6520 via homepage signup
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: cd /app/backend/tests && timeout 290 python -m pytest test_iter14_duel_done.py -n 0 (takes about 3.5 min, keep it in the foreground; a background run gets killed when the bash call ends). To test tapping another angler, log A into the browser in harbour mode, read A's x/y from POST /api/world/pos as TestAngler2, then post TestAngler2 at A.x+170, A.y. On a 1920x1080 viewport, a click at (1130,600) hits B's figure.
